caption: The drawing features two black line illustrations of a chair on a beige background. The left illustration is a front view, showing the chair's high, arched back with ornate, double-contoured edges and a dashed vertical centerline. The arms are curved, and each front leg is depicted with detailed scrollwork at the base. The seat is rectangular, and the chair’s legs are shaped, with the front legs being more ornate and the back legs straight. The right illustration is a side view of the same chair, showing the profile of the arched back, the curved armrest, a slightly reclined backrest, and the seat’s thickness. The front leg retains the scrolled detail seen in the first illustration, while the rear leg is straight and angled backward. Underneath the drawings, the text “SCALE: 2" = 1'-0"” is present. The overall composition is technical and symmetrical, focusing on structural and decorative details.
title: Arm Chair
